reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, linking local vibrational heterogeneities to phonon scattering and reduced thermal conductivity, but the specific claim of >30% improvement in RMSE is arbitrary and unsupported by the proposed mechanism.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with a well-defined falsification criterion (RMSE >30% deviation), though the practical measurement of LDOS on a combinatorial library is extremely challenging and not fully detailed.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is useful as it proposes a concrete, high-throughput experimental-computational framework to discover low-thermal-conductivity HEAs, directly addressing the research question.
